Hazy atmospheric conditions reduce long-distance visibility and may weaken hazard detection despite the straight roadway.

No benches, bus stop amenities, planting areas, or social gathering spaces are present, limiting everyday usability beyond through-traffic.

The large expanse of asphalt and concrete suggests a heat-absorbing, resource-intensive environment with limited ecological function.
